title: The super-code C+=C(+)<u1> collapses worst I(delta) into a single rank-(k+1) list-decoding radius, and the cyclic lever forces C+=RS[k+1] up to dilation
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley: even after correctly localizing to the (radius-dependent) extremal monomial direction, the worst-case far-line incidence I(delta) is the generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue B=max_{b!=0}||eta_b|| over mu_n (open). The super-code reduction does NOT remove the BGK/Paley wall; it just renames the per-Z/n-frequency object.
evidence: The connection is a 3-link chain. Links (1) and (2) are GENUINELY PROVEN in-tree and I verified them by reading: (1) SuperCodeListBridge.lean `explainableScalars_card_le_superList` (any far u1 not in C: I(u0,u1;delta) <= |list(C (+) <u1>, delta n)|, injection gamma -> c_gamma - gamma*u1, axiom-clean), and (2) FarLineIncidenceEquivariance.lean `explainableScalars_rs_rotate` / `_comp_aut` (RS dilations fix the code so I is Z/n-invariant, axiom-clean). The NEW claim (link 3 = the title, the attack-plan's `worstSuperCode_eq_RSsucc`) is FALSE: 'the cyclic lever collapses the max over far super-codes to the SINGLE RS[k+1] (direction X^k)'. Decisive exact-integer probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C048_min.py on PROPER DYADIC subgroups mu_8 of two large primes (q=257 beta=2.67, q=337 beta=2.80, both n=8<sqrt(q)), window-interior radius delta=0.625 (agree>=3/8): the C048 'worst super-code' direction u1=X^k=X^2 (super-code RS[k+1]) gives bad-scalar counts 49-55, while NON-MONOMIAL far directions (random words, and the HIGHER monomial X^3) STRICTLY BEAT it (54-56) in 7 of 8 offset samples. So RS[k+1] is provably NOT the worst-case super-code. This independently reproduces what the in-tree authors already noted in SuperCodeListBridge.lean lines 11-15 ('monomial directions are NOT the worst case in the prize regime ... worst-over-monomials sits BELOW the average pencil incidence') and the #357 campaign O137-O140 in DISPROOF_LOG.md (the extremal far direction is the twisted-monomial orbit of the ADJACENT-EXPONENT pair (X^a, X^{a-1}) with a=(1-delta)n, NOT X^k; e.g. the fiber stack (X^9,X^6) gives 4 bad scalars while (X^9,X^8) gives 12; X^3 beating X^2 in my q=337 sample is the same a=(1-delta)n=3 effect). The structural error: equivariance gives I the Z/n symmetry, i.e. I is a CLASS FUNCTION on dilation-orbits of LINES -- it lets you search a fundamental domain, but it does NOT make the dilation-FIXED point (the monomial) the MAXIMUM. Maximality at the symmetric point needs Schur-concavity/averaging, which is FALSE here (symmetric/sparse-spectrum points are atypically far and non-extremal). Two failures: (i) RS[k+1] is not worst even among monomials; (ii) the extremal exponent a moves with delta, so the worst super-code is RS[k] (+) <X^{(1-delta)n}>, NOT RS[k+1] uniformly.
honest_note: Not a clean full-connection REFUTED: the connection's two LOAD-BEARING lemmas (the super-code list bound and the cyclic equivariance) are real, proven, axiom-clean, and genuinely useful -- the refutation is confined to the headline SYNTHESIS claim that the cyclic lever PINS the worst super-code to RS[k+1] (the attack-plan target `worstSuperCode_eq_RSsucc`). The correct statement, already established in-tree (#357 O138), is the radius-dependent adjacent-pair monomial extremality conjecture: sup ranges over RS[k] (+) <X^{(1-delta)n}> via (X^a, X^{a-1}), giving ε_mca = #{-e_1(A): A in C(mu_n,a), e_2=...=e_{a-k}=0}/|F|. Even that corrected pin is itself OPEN and welds to BGK/Paley (the constrained subset-sum census over mu_n is the same vanishing-power-sum / additive-energy object as the open core). So C048's value is real as a reduction (super-code framing + cyclic symmetry) but it does NOT close anything and its 'single RS[k+1]' collapse is false. Probes are exact integer arithmetic (modular Lagrange interpolation, full gamma sweep) at small n on multiple proper dyadic large-prime subgroups; the C048_min.py result is the load-bearing numeric. Recommend adding a one-line entry to DISPROOF_LOG.md: 'super-code/dilation does NOT pin worst far direction to RS[k+1] (X^k); extremal exponent = (1-delta)n, non-monomials beat X^k -- equivariance gives invariance not maximality.' I did not run a Lean disproof (the false claim `worstSuperCode_eq_RSsucc` was never formalized; the existing files contain only the two TRUE lemmas).
